results.title: Pluto TV Reviews 2025: What Users Really Think - Pluto TV
results.content:
Advertising is the number-one complaint across all platforms. In the review sample, ad-related issues appeared in an estimated 28-32% of negative reviews. The issue isn't just that ads exist. It's the volume and repetition. Users report commercials every 6.5 to 10.5 minutes, with total ad loads reaching 14-17 minutes per viewing session. Industry data puts Pluto TV's ad load at approximately 10-12 minutes per hour, two to three times what Tubi serves at 4-6 minutes per hour.

The repetition compounds the frustration. As one Reddit user wrote: "It's always the same stupid ones over and over and over again. I must say they are not doing your platform any favors. They are beyond annoying." [...] The split isn't random. Casual mobile viewers who treat Pluto TV as background entertainment tend to rate it highly because they appreciate free access to hundreds of live channels without thinking too hard about what to watch. People who sit down for intentional, extended viewing sessions and then write detailed reviews on dedicated platforms run into the ad repetition, technical instability, and missing playback controls that make the experience frustrating.

We dug into reviews across the Apple App Store, Google Play, Trustpilot, and Reddit to understand what's happening with Pluto TV in 2025. Pluto TV works best at passive, lean-back channel surfing, and it struggles when you use it for intentional viewing, binge-watching, or reliable long-form playback. [...] The numbers are real signals, but they measure different experiences. Pluto TV can feel useful in short casual sessions and frustrating when you expect it to behave like a primary streaming service.
